Class ArrayList<E>

java.lang.Object
utils.AbstractList<E>
utils.ArrayList<E>
Type Parameters:
E - element of a list
All Implemented Interfaces:
List<E>
public class ArrayList<E> extends AbstractList<E>
This data structure will mimic some of the behaviors/features of the Java Standard Library (Java API) version of an array list (dynamic array) data structure. You are being assessed on your ability to understand the functionality of Array Lists and Lists and to implement them with coding features that the Java Language provides.

  • Constructor Details

    • ArrayList

      public ArrayList()
      The default constructor calls the second constructor, generating an internal array with the specified DEFAULT CAPACITY.

    • ArrayList

      public ArrayList(int capacity)
      The second constructor generates an internal array with the specified initial capacity. If the capacity is less than zero, this constructor should throw an IllegalArgumentException.
      Parameters:
      capacity - the initial capacity of the array list
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified capacity is negative

    • ArrayList

      public ArrayList(List<E> list)
      The third constructor generates an internal array with the elements of another list. The size of the list is the same as the list passed as a parameter.
      Parameters:
      list - the list whose elements are to be placed into this list

  • Method Details

    • ensureCapacity

      public void ensureCapacity(int minCapacity)
      checks if there is enough space in the underlying array to hold the next added item, if it doesn't it resizes the underlying array by comparing: double the current capacity + 1 of the underlying array to the required minCapacity then using the larger value to ensure the storage of all current elements + 1.
      Parameters:
      minCapacity - the desired minimum capacity

    • checkCapacity

      public void checkCapacity(int minCapacity)
      Checks capacity to ensure the array can hold the specified minimum capacity.
      Parameters:
      minCapacity - the desired minimum capacity

    • add

      public boolean add(E item)
      appends the item specified to the end of the list and updates the number of elements one at a time. This method returns true, if the data was added successfully.
      Parameters:
      item - the element to be appended to this list
      Returns:
      true if the data was added successfully

    • add

      public void add(int index, E item)
      Moves (shifts) elements at index and after to the right and then inserts the item specified at the given index in the list. This method then updates the number of elements in list one at a time.
      Parameters:
      index - index at which the specified element is to be inserted
      item - element to be inserted

    • clear

      public void clear()
      clears list of all elements from the list for garbage collection, returns size back to zero.

      public E get(int index)

      Returns:

    • indexOf

      public int indexOf(E item)
      searches for a specific item within the list and returns the first occurrence (i.e., index location) in the array if found, otherwise returns the value -1 to indicate that the item was NOT FOUND.
      Parameters:
      item - element to search for
      Returns:
      the index of the first occurrence of the specified element in this list, or -1 if this list does not contain the element

    • remove

      public E remove(int index)
      removes the item at the given index in the list. Moves (shifts) elements down one index (to the left) in list, and returns item removed. This method first checks if the index requested is valid and reduces the number of elements by one.
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the element to be removed
      Returns:
      the element that was removed from the list

    • remove

      public boolean remove(E item)
      removes the first occurrence of the item specified from the list, if present. Moves (shifts) subsequent elements to the left and returns true, if the item is removed. Reduces the number of elements by one.
      Parameters:
      item - element to be removed from this list, if present
      Returns:
      true if this list contained the specified element

    • set

      public E set(int index, E item)
      replaces the item at the specified position with the one specified. This method validates the index before replacing the item.
      Parameters:
      index - index of the element to replace
      item - element to be stored at the specified position
      Returns:
      the element previously at the specified position

      returns the number of elements in the list. This is the size of the occupied locations of the array.

      the number of elements in this list
